events.summary: Dovin ticks off the planeswalkers on Ravnica: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska and Bolas.
events.quote: Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers

events.summary: Kaya ends a meeting of the Obzedat convened by Teysa.
events.quote: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.

events.summary: Kaya tells Teysa it is time to let the dead be dead.
events.quote: Time to let the dead be dead.

events.summary: The Chamber of the Guildpact falls silent, its promise broken.
events.quote: The Chamber of the Guildpact has fallen silent, its bright promise broken.

events.summary: Lazav warns that Dovin Baan came from nowhere and is more than he appears.
events.quote: This Dovin Baan came from nowhere.

events.summary: Ravnicans search the city for Fblthp.
events.quote: Searching the city for Fblthp felt like sifting the rain for a single drop of blood.

events.summary: Orzhov vampires look for allies in case their new guildmaster turns on them after the fate of the Obzedat.
events.quote: The fate of the Obzedat is proof of Kaya's power and her hatred of the living dead.

events.summary: Domri's ascent is seen by some as a sign of Ilharg's return.
events.quote: Some view Domri's unlikely ascent as a sign of Ilharg the Raze-Boar's imminent return.

events.summary: Domri says no peace accord will save Ravnica and it must be burned down.
events.quote: No peace accord will save Ravnica.

events.summary: Nikya foretells the End-Raze and the Gruul dancing in Ravnica's rubble.
events.quote: What we begin, the End-Raze will finish.

events.summary: Aurelia demands justice if peace cannot be had.
events.quote: If we cannot have peace, we will have justice.

relations.note: Teysa is at the center of the Orzhov web of power.
relations.quote: Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

relations.note: Thados is a Guardian Project biomancer.
